# Revital Daycare
Last-Modified: 2026-08-30
> Quality preschool and early childhood education in Winnetka, CA. Serving children ages 3-5 with play-based, nurturing care and kindergarten readiness.

## Brand
- Name: Revital Daycare
- Tagline: Nurturing preschool for ages 3-5 in Winnetka, CA
- Philosophy: Play-based, child-centered approach inspired by Reggio Emilia principles
- Founded by: Revital Edry (10 years early childhood education experience)
- License: California Department of Social Services (CDSS License #197312451)

## Service Areas
- Winnetka, CA (home location)
- Woodland Hills, CA
- Canoga Park, CA
- Chatsworth, CA
- West San Fernando Valley
